title: Offentligt udbud af vejservice og grøn drift til Gribskov Kommune
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers levering af vejservice og grøn drift. Ydelsen omfatter dels planlagte eller rekvirerede arbejder til udførelseskrav og dels arbejder til tilstandskrav. Opdelingen af ydelser er baseret på Ordregivers behov for udførelse af ydelser på de respektive fagområder. Udbuddet er opdelt i otte (8) delaftaler (herefter ”fagleverancer”) nedenfor, som hver omfatter nærmere afgrænsede drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver inden for vejdrift og grøn service. Ydelserne kan bestå af planlagte eller rekvirerede arbejder til udførelseskrav samt arbejder til tilstandskrav. - Fagleverance 1: Brolægning - Fagleverance 2: Rabatregulering og Gruspladser, -stier og -veje - Fagleverance 3: Tømning af brønde - Fagleverance 4: Rabatgræs - Fagleverance 5: Gartnerdrift - Fagleverance 6: Færdselstavler og vejinventar - Fagleverance 7: Fejning af kørebaner - Fagleverance 8: Fejning og ukrudtsbekæmpelse på faste belægninger Fagleverancerne er opdelt for at gøre det muligt for mindre og mellemstore virksomheder at byde på opgaven. Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere af de udbudte fagleverancer. I skal i ESPD del ll.A. angive, hvilke fagleverancer I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud per fagleverance, som I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at det maksimalt er muligt for en Tilbudsgiver at få tildelt tre (3) fagleverancer. Fagleverancerne er uddybet i punktet Delaftalebetingelser.

Mahdollisesti, esimerkiksi useampaa toimialuetta koskevien laajempien yhteysvälitarkastelujen tapauksessa, yksittäisen toimeksiannon rahoitukseen voi osallistua myös Pohjanmaan elinvoimakeskuksen toimialueen ulkopuolinen taho.,

title: Dekningskjøp av mobiltelefoner
description: Avtalen skal bestå av følgende: • Iphone17 256GB • Iphone18 Pro 256GB • Iphone18 Pro Max 256 GB Modellene skal tilbys i alle tilgjengelige farger. Valg av farge på mobiltelefon skal ikke medføre endring av pris. Det skal også være mulig å kjøpe Iphone-er med høyere lagringskapasitet. Leverandørene kan ikke beregne høyere prosent-avanse på en mobiltelefonmodell med en annen lagringskapasitet enn de tilbudte variantene. Det skal i tillegg være mulig å kjøpe Apple earpod*, lader, etui, deksel og skjermbeskyttelse til mobiltelefonmodellene på avtalen. *Merk at det er Apple earpod og ikke airpod som etterspørres. Dekningskjøp Departementsfellesskapet har dekket behovet for mobile enheter gjennom den statlige fellesavtalen på mobile enheter fra Statens innkjøpssenter (DFØ). Den fellesavtalen fra DFØ løp ut 2. september 2026. Ny statlig fellesavtale er p.t. ikke på plass, og følgelig står departementsfellesskapet uten noen avtale på mobile enheter. Volumdriveren for departementsfellesskapet i avtalen på mobile enheter er mobiltelefoner (Iphone-er) og en midlertidig avtale som løper frem til DFØ får på plass ny statlig fellesavtale for mobile enheter, er derfor påkrevd.

title: Ny oppvarmingsløysing for Lustrabadet
description: Bakgrunn Lustrabadet har behov for å fornye oppvarmingsløysinga for både basseng og bygningsvarme. Dagens løysing er basert på elkjel og medfører høgt energiforbruk. Verksemda ønskjer derfor ei meir energieffektiv og framtidsretta løysing som kan redusere energibruken og samtidig sikre stabil varmeforsyning. Oppvarminga er ein kritisk del av drifta i badeanlegget, der det er viktig med jamne temperaturar, høg driftstryggleik og god kapasitet også i periodar med låg utetemperatur og høg belastning. Anskaffinga skal leggje til rette for ei løysing som fungerer godt i samspel med eksisterande tekniske anlegg og som kan nyttast innanfor planlagde driftsstansar. Eksisterande elkjel er på 400 kW og skal vidareførast som backup. Det er derfor behov for ei ny hovudløysing som kan integrerast med denne og med eksisterande SD-anlegg, slik at anlegget får betre styring, overvaking og tryggleik i den daglege drifta. Skildring av oppdraget Oppdraget omfattar levering av ei ny oppvarmingsløysing for Lustrabadet for oppvarming av både basseng og bygg. Anskaffinga omfattar komplett leveranse med prosjektering/tilpassing, installasjon, integrasjon, testing, idriftsetjing, opplæring og nødvendig driftsdokumentasjon. Det blir etterspurt ei energieffektiv løysing som kan levere stabil og jamn varme, ha høg driftstryggleik og vere eigna for samtidig oppvarming av basseng og bygg. Løysinga skal kunne fungere godt også ved låg utetemperatur og under belastningstoppar. Oppdragsgivar er open for ulike tekniske løysingar. Leveransen skal omfatte integrasjon mot eksisterande SD-anlegg og energistyring, samt samkopling med eksisterande elkjel som backup. Det skal leggjast til rette for omkopling ved behov, slik at varmeforsyninga blir halden oppe ved service, driftsstans eller annan nedetid på hovudløysinga. Gjennomføringa må tilpassast planlagd driftsstans i badeanlegget i veke 18 og 19. Om det er mogleg med gjennomføring utan driftsstans, opnar me for at installering kan gjerast tidlegare. Leverandøren må derfor tilby ei løysing og ein gjennomføringsmåte som tek omsyn til avgrensa tilgjengeleg installasjonsvindauge.

title: Vannmålere med fjernavlesning og lekkasjedeteksjon
description: Bakgrunn og dagens situasjon Kommunestyret i Sandefjord kommune vedtok i sak 096/26 01.10.2026 endring av forskrift om vann- og avløpsgebyrer, med innføring av vannmålere til alle abonnenter. I forbindelse med den vedtatte innføringen er det behov for en avtale for vannmålere som dekker kommunens fremtidige behov. Dagens løsning har begrenset støtte for fjernavlesning og overvåking. Det er derfor behov for en mer oppdatert og driftsvennlig målerløsning som gir bedre kontroll, mer stabil automatisk avlesning og bedre grunnlag for oppfølging av abonnenter. Beskrivelse av behov Kommunen har behov for ultralydmålere for alle abonnenter, med fjernavlesning med bruk av NB-IoT som standard. Målerne må være robuste og egnet for bruk i ulike abonnenttyper, både næring og bolig/fritidsbolig. Det er et sentralt behov at målerne har funksjonalitet for lekkasjedeteksjon før måleren, slik at lekkasjer på stikkledninger før måler kan oppdages tidlig. Løsningen skal bidra til enklere drift og bedre kontroll gjennom automatisk og stabil innhenting av måledata og alarmdata. Tekniske og funksjonelle krav Den nye løsningen må understøtte sikker dataflyt og automatisk overføring av måleverdier og alarmer. Det er behov for varsling til drift ved avvik og lekkasje, samt tilgang til historikk og analyser per vannmåler. Løsningen bør ha en plattform for avlesning og oppfølging av målerne, samt mulighet for integrasjon mot kommunens gebyrsystem, pt Norkart. Behovet omfatter en løsning som samlet sett gir bedre overvåking, tidlig oppdagelse av lekkasjer og en mer effektiv forvaltning av vannmålerdata. Omfang og innfasing Innføringen skal skje trinnvis. Installasjon av vannmålere starter i bygg der det gjøres endringer, samt i nye bygg. Det skal senere legges frem en ny politisk sak med mer detaljert gjennomgang av gjennomføring og kostnader knyttet til eksisterende bygg innen utgangen av 2026. Målet er at alle husstander skal installere vannmålere ila en fireårsperiode, men dette er avhengig av politisk vedtak og budsjett.

title: Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC
description: 26/11/02 Update site questions on October 1, 2026. see attachments: B14 and A15. Sources Sought (SS) / Request for Information (RFI) This Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government will not reimburse accompanying costs. Any answers or attachments provided are based upon the best information available at the time of the visit and are subject to change. 1. Background & Purpose USDA Forest Service seeks capability statements from qualified vendors able to conduct fuels reduction on steep and rugged terrain within Bozeman Municipal Watershed Project area for the anticipated Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC. The purpose of this SS/RFI is to gather information on vendor capabilities, invite prospective vendors to an organized site visit on 10/01/2026, and to view the area before snow limits access. 2. Anticipated Scope of Work Cut and removal of approximately 290 CCF of Lodgepole pine sawtimber 2045 CCF of Douglas-fir and other Sawtimber on 151 acres. Whole-tree Helicopter yarding of included timber. Piling of slash at the landing area. Road Decommissioning of .59 miles of existing Temporary Road Use Permit (TRUP) roads post-hauling. 3. Place of Performance The Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC project is located in the northern Gallatin Mountain Range, just south of Bozeman, MT. Helicopter units are located on the west side of FS Road #979, along Bozeman Creek and adjacent to City of Bozeman land. 4. Period of Performance Anticipated start date: Late Spring/Early Summer 2027. Period of performance is estimated to not exceed two operational seasons and is dependent on weather, access, and coordination. 5. Site Visit An organized site visit will occur on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. MDT. Interested parties will meet at the Bozeman Ranger District located at 3710 Fallon St. Suite C. Bozeman, MT 59718. Interested parties should contact Nathan Motzko at nathan.motzko@usda.gov or 406-224-0323 by 12:00 p.m. MDT on September 30, 2026, if they intend to attend. 6. Requested Capability Statement Content Company information (UEI, address, email, POC, socio-economic status). Relevant experience, especially hazardous fuel reduction, helicopter yarding, steep slope timber operations. Safety program details and crew qualifications. Equipment lists and mobilization capabilities. Past performance references. 7. Response Instructions & Due Date Any information submitted by vendors to this this SS/RFI is voluntary. Responses should be submitted electronically to Jeanne Windle at norma.windle@usda.gov. All responses are due no later than October 15, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. MDT. 8. Points of Contact Direct all questions via email to Jeanne Windle, Contracting Officer at norma.windle@usda.gov.

title: Extension du terminal côté ville [EMT LANDSIDE] - Marché 1 : Plateformes multimodales
description:
Le projet Évolution Modulaire du Terminal (EMT) vise à étendre et rénover les infrastructures terminales de l’Aéroport de Bâle-Mulhouse afin d’améliorer la qualité de service aux passagers. La présente consultation s’inscrit dans le 1er module du projet, intitulé « EMT Landside », qui comprend :

  • la construction d’une extension du terminal côté ville ;
  • la rénovation dans le terminal existant ;
  • la réalisation d’aménagements extérieurs.


La réalisation de EMT Landside est organisée en trois (3) marchés de travaux distincts :

  • Marché n°1 : Plateformes multimodales ;
  • Marché n°2 : Extension du terminal et réaménagement des espaces existants ;
  • Marché n°3 : Parvis piéton végétalisé.


Le présent avis concerne le marché de travaux n°1 – Plateformes multimodales, portant notamment sur :

  • la création des rampes d’accès des parkings F1 et S1 ;
  • la réalisation des plateformes multimodales française et suisse ;
  • l’aménagement des locaux CFO/CFA dans les parkings F1 et S1 ;
  • l’aménagement de locaux destinés au Poste Central de Sécurité (PCS) et à la Police aux Frontières (PAF) ;
  • la démolition du viaduc ;
  • la déconstruction de la partie centrale du viaduc ainsi que des rampes d’accès Est ;
  • la viabilisation de la logistique provisoire ;
  • la réalisation des installations provisoires nécessaires au maintien des accès passagers.


Phasage des travaux : Les prestations seront exécutées selon un phasage défini dans les documents de la consultation. Ce phasage tiendra notamment compte du maintien en exploitation des infrastructures aéroportuaires et de la continuité des accès.


Information sur les lots : Le marché n’est pas divisé en lots, il constitue un marché unique de travaux Tous Corps d’Etats (TCE) portant sur l’intégralité de son périmètre découpé en 19 volets/lots techniques et architecturaux définis dans l'avis de marché disponible sur le profil d'acheteur

à l’adresse : https://www.marches-securises.fr/.

title: Abschlussevaluation des Rahmenprogramms Gesundheitsforschung der Bundesregierung
description: Gegenstand des Auftrags ist die Abschlussevaluation des Rahmenprogramms Gesundheitsforschung der Bundesregierung. Mit der Evaluation soll untersucht werden, inwieweit die beiden Leitlinien „Der Mensch im Mittelpunkt“ (Partizipation) und „Personalisierung und Digitalisierung als Schlüssel“ als Querschnittsaufgaben im Rahmenprogramm Gesundheitsforschung bislang im Förderhandeln des Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt (BMFTR) umgesetzt wurden und welche Wirkungen auf die Forschungsprojekte, -einrichtungen und -strukturen sich daraus ergeben haben. Dafür sind drei Arbeitspakete vorgesehen: AP 1 Partizipation, AP 2 Digitalisierung und AP 3 Partizipation. In jedem Arbeitspaket werden die Förderrichtlinien der Abteilung „Gesundheit und Lebenswissenschaften“ aus dem Blickwinkel der jeweiligen Fragestellung betrachtet. Die empirischen Befunde der Abschlussevaluation sollen handlungs- und steuerungsrelevante Informationen liefern, die für die Gestaltung des nächsten Rahmenprogramms Gesundheitsforschung genutzt werden können.

title: France – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Extension du terminal côté ville [EMT LANDSIDE] - Marché 1 : Plateformes multimodales
description: Le projet Évolution Modulaire du Terminal (EMT) vise à étendre et rénover les infrastructures terminales de l'Aéroport de Bâle-Mulhouse afin d'améliorer la qualité de service aux passagers. La présente consultation s'inscrit dans le 1er module du projet, intitulé « EMT Landside », qui comprend la construction d'une extension du terminal côté ville ; la rénovation dans le terminal existant ; la réalisation d'aménagements extérieurs. La réalisation de EMT Landside est organisée en trois (3) marchés de travaux distincts : Marché n°1 : Plateformes multimodales ; Marché n°2 : Extension du terminal et réaménagement des espaces existants ; Marché n°3 : Parvis piéton végétalisé. Le présent avis concerne le marché de travaux n°1 - Plateformes multimodales, portant notamment sur : - la création des rampes d'accès des parkings F1 et S1 ; - la réalisation des plateformes multimodales française et suisse ; - l'aménagement des locaux CFO/CFA dans les parkings F1 et S1 ; - l'aménagement de locaux destinés au Poste Central de Sécurité (PCS) et à la Police aux Frontières (PAF) ; - la démolition du viaduc ; - la déconstruction de la partie centrale du viaduc ainsi que des rampes d'accès Est ; - la viabilisation de la logistique provisoire ; - la réalisation des installations provisoires nécessaires au maintien des accès passagers. Phasage des travaux : Les prestations seront exécutées selon un phasage défini dans les documents de la consultation. Ce phasage tiendra notamment compte du maintien en exploitation des infrastructures aéroportuaires et de la continuité des accès. Les documents sont disponibles gratuitement, en version provisoire et à titre d'information (phase candidatures), à l'adresse : https://www.marches-securises.fr/. Informations complémentaires : Toutes les questions sont à poser via le profil d'acheteur https://www.marches-securises.fr/

description: The purpose of this framework is for the provision of Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment services that fall under the Lots listed in the ITT. Services offered under this framework will meet the highest industry standards and support Beneficiaries with the current and future day-to-day activities in respect of the requirements. The intention is to offer an accessible and compliant route to market for organisations to easily manage multiple services, assisting Beneficiaries in the management of waiting list within services to meet NHS targets. The framework will be comprised of 9 lots: • Lot 1 - Dermatology • Lot 2 - Oral and Maxillofacial surgery • Lot 3 - Audiology • Lot 4 - Ophthalmology • Lot 5 - ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat) • Lot 6 - Gastroenterology • Lot 7 - Urology • Lot 8 - Endoscopy • Lot 9 - Managed Services This is the first reopening of the framework as described in the original framework documents - 2025/S 000-055693 The term of the framework will be 2 years plus an optional one year extension. This framework is being run under the Provider Selection Regime. The framework is for the benefit of existing and emerging organisations during the life of the Contract and is intended to support Relevant Authorities when procuring such services. Relevant authorities as follows: • NHS England • Integrated care boards (ICBs) • NHS trusts and NHS foundation trusts • Local authorities and combined authorities. This framework is not accessible by Authorities in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.

title: CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES, WHITEHORSE CADET TRAINING CENTRE WHITEHORSE
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE Construction Management Services, Whitehorse cadet training centre whitehorse, yukon (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Whitehorse, Yukon. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES The objective of this contract is to recapitalize both vertical and horizontal infrastructure at the Whitehorse Cadet Training Centre (WCTC) through a multi-year program. The existing WCTC site includes a diverse portfolio of facilities comprising 39 buildings with a total floor area of approximately 5,000 m². These facilities include barracks with associated ablution areas, classrooms, a combined kitchen/dining/administration building, a large storage warehouse, and various workshops and auxiliary support structures. The recapitalization program will encompass the renovation of existing buildings, as well as the demolition and reconstruction of selected facilities, to modernize and enhance the overall functionality of the site. Project delivery will be undertaken using a Construction Management (CM) contract. The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In support of these commitments, DND aims to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through meaningful subcontracting, employment, and training related to the proposed project. To align with these objectives, the successful proponents will be required to develop an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) as part of the CM contract. The IBPs will outline proposed initiatives and opportunities for Indigenous participation, including subcontracting, employment, and training activities. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN: APN_NPYKCM01 Approximate Estimate: $50M Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for contract award, a proponent  will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS) 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors  that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors  that do not submit a proposal  will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Eric Ndayambaza Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada Eric.Ndayambaza@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Email: +(1) 343-576-9347 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

The River Class Destroyer (RCD) Extension to the A-Jetty may be added by change order. The resulting Contract will include an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) that aims to provide opportunities for businesses owned and lead by Indigenous People. Canada’s free trade agreements pose no impediment to the inclusion of measures for the benefit of Indigenous Peoples and/or businesses in a procurement. Refer to the Tender documents for details. The estimated cost for this opportunity is in the range of $280,000,000 which includes an estimated $20 million for the RCD Extension planned change order work. title: SEPA PARKING LOT REPAVING AND REPAIRS
description: Request for Proposal (RFP) Project Title: SEPA Parking Lot Repaving and Repairs Solicitation Number: 89503511102026 The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Southeastern Power Administration (SEPA) is soliciting proposals from qualified contractors to perform parking lot repaving and repair services at its office facility. The required work shall be performed in accordance with the attached Performance-Based Statement of Work (PWS), which outlines the project scope, technical specifications, performance requirements, and expected outcomes. The applicable evaluation criteria are also included in the solicitation documents. Project Objective The objective of this acquisition is to restore the existing parking lot to a safe, structurally sound, properly drained, and fully functional condition suitable for use by government employees, visitors, and authorize vehicles. All work shall be completed in accordance with the requirements and specifications identified in the PWS. Location and Time of Performance Southeastern Power Administration, 1166 Athens Tech Drive, Elberton Ga. 30635. The available times are Monday-Friday 6:30am - 5:00pm Site Visit Prospective contractors are strongly encouraged, but not required, to participate in a site visit to assess existing conditions, evaluate the scope of work, and obtain a clear understanding of the project requirements before submitting a quotation. Failure to attend the site visit will not preclude a contractor from submitting a quotation or receiving consideration for award. The vendor has the option to conduct an on-site visit to determine the best approach for Southeastern Power project. Site visits will take place on November 19, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time and November 30, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Please email tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov with your preferred attendance time. Due to security requirements, all attendees must have a valid photo ID (i.e. State Driver's License) with REAL ID compliance to gain access to the site. All contractors must submit a list of attendees at least 24 hours in advance to: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov. Please ensure that your list includes the name as it appears on your State ID and the company that will be attending. Contractors who do not possess a REAL-ID-compliant form of identification will be denied entry. Contract Type and Award SEPA anticipates awarding one (1) Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract for the parking lot repaving and repairing project. The acquisition will be conducted using Simplified Acquisition Procedures in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 13, as applicable. Award will be given to the responsible contractor whose proposal represents the best value to the government, based on the evaluation criteria established in the solicitation. Proposal Submission Deadline All proposals must be received by December 15, 2026, no later than 12:00 p.m. (noon), Eastern Standard Time (EST) Proposals may be submitted by mail to: 1166 Athens Tech Rd, Elberton, GA 30635 (addressed to: Tabitha Rambert) or electronically via email to: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov Questions and Clarifications All questions, answers, requests for clarification, or inquiries concerning this solicitation will be provided to all offerors, posted on sam.gov by December 9, 2026, and shall be directed to both designated Contracting Officers: Primary: Tabitha Rambert, Contracting Officer (tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov) Alternate: Juvonna Mattox, Contracting Officer (juvonna.mattox@sepa.doe.gov) Any changes or clarifications affecting solicitation requirements will be communicated through an official solicitation amendment, as appropriate (via Sam.gov). Submission Timeline Site Visit: November 19, 2026, at 10:30am and November 30, 2026 @1:00 pm, Eastern Time Deadline for submission of all questions will be December 4, 2026 @12:00 pm Eastern time and Deadline for responses will be December 9, 2026, on Sam.gov Bid Submission Deadline: 3pm Eastern Time on December 15, 2026 Expected Decision Date: December 31, 2026 Vendor Start date: Within 30 days of Award Please submit all proposals to the CO via email at: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov or via mail to:1166 Athens Tech Rd Elberton, GA 30635 before Bid Submission Deadline: 3pm Eastern Time on December 15, 2026. Vendor close-out date: NLT 2 Months from the vendor start date NOTE TO OFFERORS: The Statement of Work (SOW), applicable Wage Determinations, and Aeriel View are incorporated as attachments to this announcement. Offerors are responsible for thoroughly reviewing the solicitation and all accompanying attachments to ensure that their proposals comply with the stated requirements, and all are submitted by the specified deadline. Any amendments to the solicitation will be posted on this website. You are responsible for checking the website periodically. All offerors MUST be registered in System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov to be eligible for award of contract. The Government will evaluate proposals in accordance with the evaluation criteria established in the solicitation and applicable provisions of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR). The Government reserves the right to make an award to the responsible offeror, whose proposal represents the best overall value to the Government, considering the stated evaluation factors.

description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT. The FAA is seeking interest in a Grounds Maintenance Service contract at Albuquerque ARTCC (ZAB), 8000 Louisiana Blvd. NE, Albuquerque, NM 87109. The SOW with photos is attached to this announcement. If interested please email Carey.Gonzalez@FAA.gov with a CC of Josh.Haker@FAA.gov. The email subject must include "ZAB Grounds Maintenance-Interested Vendor" along with your company's capability statement and the following: Company Name: Company POC: Company Phone: Company Email: Company UEI: Weed control and groundskeeping services in Albuquerque, NM typically involve a variety of tasks aimed at maintaining the health, appearance, and functionality of outdoor spaces, whether they are residential, commercial, or public areas. These services can include: Weed Control: This involves the removal and prevention of unwanted plants and weeds that can affect the health of desired plants and the aesthetics of the landscape. Services may include manual removal, chemical treatments, and organic solutions tailored to the specific needs of the area. Lawn Care: Regular mowing, edging, aeration, fertilization, and reseeding are part of lawn care services to ensure a lush and healthy lawn. Providers often focus on using practices suitable for Albuquerque�s climate, including drought-resistant strategies. Landscaping: Design and maintenance of gardens and outdoor spaces, including planting flowers, shrubs, and trees that are suitable for the local climate. Landscaping might also include hardscaping elements such as patios, walkways, and irrigation systems. Tree and Shrub Care: Trimming, pruning, and health assessments for trees and shrubs are important to prevent disease, encourage growth, and maintain safety. Irrigation Systems: Installation and maintenance of irrigation systems to ensure efficient water use, crucial in Albuquerque�s arid environment. This might include drip systems or smart irrigation technologies. Seasonal Cleanups: Removal of leaves, debris, and other waste, particularly during fall and spring, to maintain a neat appearance and prevent plant disease. Pest Control: Management of pests that can damage plants and lawns, using environmentally friendly methods where possible. Groundskeeping for Commercial Properties: Enhanced services that may include parking lot maintenance, exterior cleaning, and snow removal in winter months. Providers in Albuquerque may offer customized plans based on the unique requirements of the property and the preferences of the property owner. Additionally, they typically emphasize sustainable practices to cope with the region's water scarcity and environmental concerns.

title: NAWCAD (WOLF) Airborne Systems Integration (ASI ) Division Technical/Project Management Support (TPMS)
description: Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), Webster Outlying Field (WOLF), Airborne Systems Integration (ASI) Division intends to issue a competitive, total small business set-aside Request for Offers (RFO) under the SeaPort Next Generation (NxG) Multiple Award Contract for Airborne Systems Integration (ASI) Technical/Project Management Support (TPMS). The resulting Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee task order will provide technical project-management, data-management, and acquisition support for ASI Division requirements. Support includes project planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout; division-level planning and performance reporting; data analytics, metrics, and repeatable best practices. The effort supports multiple defense acquisition programs and weapons systems, including�but not limited to�VH-92A, E-6B, unmanned carrier aviation, counter-uncrewed systems, V-22, and Naval Sea Systems Command Integrated Warfare Systems Program Executive Office requirements. Performance is anticipated at Government sites in St. Inigoes, Maryland, and Patuxent River, Maryland, with limited contractor-site performance within 50 drivable miles of NAWCAD WOLF. A Secret Facility Clearance Level is required.

title: National Veterans Sports Programs & Special Events National Veterans Golden Age Games (NVGAG) National Veterans Creative Arts Festival (NVCAF) Transportation
description: This Performance Work Statement (PWS) defines the requirements for transportation services under an Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. The contract supports two national?level Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) programs: � The National Veterans Golden Age Games (NVGAG), including annual site visits and event transportation during the ordering period. � The National Veterans Creative Arts Festival (NVCAF) for designated event years. This IDIQ provides a unified scope of transportation services required to support recurring national VA events. Each task order will define the event year, schedule, required vehicle quantities, routing requirements, and operational details. Except where a minimum is stated, passenger counts and quantities in this PWS are planning figures; each task order will state the firm requirements. 1.1 National Veterans Golden Age Games (NVGAG) NVGAG is a national senior adaptive rehabilitation program promoting fitness, independence, and quality of life for older Veterans. It features multi?event athletic competitions and recreational activities for Veterans with varying levels of physical ability. NVGAG also serves as a qualifying event for participation in the National Senior Games. 1.2 National Veterans Creative Arts Festival (NVCAF) The National Veterans Creative Arts Festival empowers Veterans to improve their mental and physical health through therapeutic creative arts experiences. The event reinforces the VA�s commitment to whole health, recovery-oriented care, and Veteran-centered services by celebrating resilience, achievement, and personal growth. Showcasing the intersection of artistry and healing, the event features National Veteran medalists invited for their artistic achievements and therapeutic use of the arts.

Please refer to the attachments section to access the updated documents. ________________________________________________________________________ Description The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Capital Projects Contracting Division, is pleased to announce the issuance of a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a highly qualified Contractor who can provide Construction Services to perform a Seismic Retrofit at the Clemente Ruiz Nazario U.S. Courthouse (Nazario Courthouse) located at 150 Carlos Chardon Avenue in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The Nazario Courthouse will remain fully operational throughout the duration of the Seismic Retrofit. To ensure minimal disruption to Government operations, the work will predominantly be executed after business hours. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Government�s requirements for access and security. Additionally, the General Contractor will be required to complete this project in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications that will be issued for this project. Contract Type: The contract type for this procurement will be Firm-Fixed price. The line item schedule will include a lump sum item for the Base and Options. Price: The total magnitude of this project at award is between $40,000,000 and $50,000,000. Selection and Schedule: The General Contractor will be selected through a procurement method developed in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Part 15 Contracting by Negotiation (Class Deviation RFO-2025-15) and FAR 36 Construction and Architect-Engineer Contracts (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-36). The intended project delivery method is a Phased Acquisition procurement using a Two-Phase Evaluation process. During Phase I, prospective firms must submit technical qualifications detailing their experience with comparable efforts and previous records of past-performance. In Phase II, selected General Contractors shall demonstrate their operational strategy and planned subcontracting framework. Evaluation of Phase II technical submissions will be conducted in full before the Government reviews the price proposal. GSA anticipates award of a contract for these services in August 2027. The period of performance for the proposed contract will be for approximately forty six (46) months upon issuance of notice to proceed. NAICS: This procurement will be conducted under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 236220--Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business size standard is an average annual sales and receipts for the past three (3) years that are equal to or less than $45,000,000. All offerors are required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (www.SAM.gov) at the time of offer submission, and shall continue to be registered until time of award, during performance, and through final payment of any contract. Interested offerors - See all attached solicitation file packages for full details. Some of the solicitation documents are Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). To access these documents your company must request access through www.sam.gov. Proposals for this Solicitation must be submitted via e-mail in portable document format (PDF). Proposals MUST BE RECEIVED NO LATER THAN stated due date and time in this solicitation. Inquiries concerning this solicitation must be routed to Contracting Officer Natalia Lugo-Vina at natalia.lugo-vinacruz.gsa.gov. Prospective offerors bear sole responsibility for tracking and retrieving the RFP alongside all associated modifications.

title: NIH MULTIPLE-AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) FOR GENERAL CONSTRUCTION SERVICES
description: SOLICITATION NOTICE MULTIPLE-AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) FOR GENERAL CONSTRUCTION SERVICES Solicitation No. 75N99027R00002 The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Acquisition and Logistics Management (OALM), Construction, A&E, Facilities and Leasing Office (CAFLO), anticipates issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Multiple-Award Construction Contract (MACC) to support the ongoing construction, alteration, repair, and maintenance requirements of the NIH Office of Research Facilities (ORF). The resulting contracts will be multiple-award Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) construction contracts. Work will be authorized through individually issued task orders. This acquisition is anticipated to be conducted using competitive negotiated procedures under FAR Part 15. The Government intends to award multiple IDIQ construction contracts under FAR Subpart 16.5. Individual task orders will generally be awarded on a firm-fixed-price basis. The anticipated aggregate ceiling is $3 billion over an eight-year ordering period. Individual construction requirements will be competed through task orders among eligible MACC awardees in accordance with the ordering procedures established in the resulting contracts. The solicitation and resulting contracts will include procedures for adding and removing awardees during that period (on/off ramp). The initial seed-project scope estimated construction magnitude, applicable evaluation factors, and proposal submission requirements will be provided in the solicitation. SCOPE OF WORK Work under the MACC will primarily consist of general construction and may include, but is not limited to, maintenance, repair, painting, alterations, architectural work, mechanical systems, electrical systems, plumbing, heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC), civil work, earthwork, fencing, structural work, steel fabrication and welding, roofing, building renovations, demolition, new building construction, sustainable construction, design-bid-build, and design-build projects. title: General Contractor for the Seismic Retrofit Project at the Clemente Ruiz Nazario U.S. Courthouse, San Juan, Puerto Rico
description: Description The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service, Capital Projects Contracting Division, is pleased to announce the issuance of a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a highly qualified Contractor who can provide Construction Services to perform a Seismic Retrofit at the Clemente Ruiz Nazario U.S. Courthouse (Nazario Courthouse) located at 150 Carlos Chardon Avenue in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The Nazario Courthouse will remain fully operational throughout the duration of the Seismic Retrofit. To ensure minimal disruption to Government operations, the work will predominantly be executed after business hours. The selected General Contractor will be required to ensure full compliance with the Government�s requirements for access and security. Additionally, the General Contractor will be required to complete this project in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications that will be issued for this project. Contract Type: The contract type for this procurement will be Firm-Fixed price. The line item schedule will include a lump sum item for the Base and Options. Price: The total magnitude of this project at award is between $40,000,000 and $50,000,000. Selection and Schedule: The General Contractor will be selected through a procurement method developed in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Part 15 Contracting by Negotiation (Class Deviation RFO-2025-15) and FAR 36 Construction and Architect-Engineer Contracts (GSA Class Deviation RFO-2025-36). The intended project delivery method is a Phased Acquisition procurement using a Two-Phase Evaluation process. During Phase I, prospective firms must submit technical qualifications detailing their experience with comparable efforts and previous records of past-performance. In Phase II, selected General Contractors shall demonstrate their operational strategy and planned subcontracting framework. Evaluation of Phase II technical submissions will be conducted in full before the Government reviews the price proposal. GSA anticipates award of a contract for these services in August 2027. The period of performance for the proposed contract will be for approximately forty six (46) months upon issuance of notice to proceed. NAICS: This procurement will be conducted under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 236220--Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. The Small Business size standard is an average annual sales and receipts for the past three (3) years that are equal to or less than $45,000,000. All offerors are required to have an active registration in the System for Award Management (www.SAM.gov) at the time of offer submission, and shall continue to be registered until time of award, during performance, and through final payment of any contract. Interested offerors - See all attached solicitation file packages for full details. Some of the solicitation documents are Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI). To access these documents your company must request access through www.sam.gov. Proposals for this Solicitation must be submitted via e-mail in portable document format (PDF). Proposals MUST BE RECEIVED NO LATER THAN stated due date and time in this solicitation. Inquiries concerning this solicitation must be routed to Contracting Officer Natalia Lugo-Vina at natalia.lugo-vinacruz.gsa.gov. Prospective offerors bear sole responsibility for tracking and retrieving the RFP alongside all associated modifications.

title: SEPA PARKING LOT REPAVING AND REPAIRS
description: Request for Proposal (RFP) Project Title: SEPA Parking Lot Repaving and Repairs Solicitation Number: 89503511102026 The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), Southeastern Power Administration (SEPA) is soliciting proposals from qualified contractors to perform parking lot repaving and repair services at its office facility. The required work shall be performed in accordance with the attached Performance-Based Statement of Work (PWS), which outlines the project scope, technical specifications, performance requirements, and expected outcomes. The applicable evaluation criteria are also included in the solicitation documents. Project Objective The objective of this acquisition is to restore the existing parking lot to a safe, structurally sound, properly drained, and fully functional condition suitable for use by government employees, visitors, and authorize vehicles. All work shall be completed in accordance with the requirements and specifications identified in the PWS. Location and Time of Performance Southeastern Power Administration, 1166 Athens Tech Drive, Elberton Ga. 30635. The available times are Monday-Friday 6:30am - 5:00pm Site Visit Prospective contractors are strongly encouraged, but not required, to participate in a site visit to assess existing conditions, evaluate the scope of work, and obtain a clear understanding of the project requirements before submitting a quotation. Failure to attend the site visit will not preclude a contractor from submitting a quotation or receiving consideration for award. The vendor has the option to conduct an on-site visit to determine the best approach for Southeastern Power project. Site visits will take place on November 19, 2026 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time and November 30, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Please email tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov with your preferred attendance time. Due to security requirements, all attendees must have a valid photo ID (i.e. State Driver's License) with REAL ID compliance to gain access to the site. All contractors must submit a list of attendees at least 24 hours in advance to: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov. Please ensure that your list includes the name as it appears on your State ID and the company that will be attending. Contractors who do not possess a REAL-ID-compliant form of identification will be denied entry. Contract Type and Award SEPA anticipates awarding one (1) Firm Fixed Price (FFP) contract for the parking lot repaving and repairing project. The acquisition will be conducted using Simplified Acquisition Procedures in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 13, as applicable. Award will be given to the responsible contractor whose proposal represents the best value to the government, based on the evaluation criteria established in the solicitation. Proposal Submission Deadline All proposals must be received by December 15, 2026, no later than 3:00 p.m. (noon), Eastern Standard Time (EST) Proposals may be submitted by mail to: 1166 Athens Tech Rd, Elberton, GA 30635 (addressed to: Tabitha Rambert) or electronically via email to: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov Questions and Clarifications All questions, answers, requests for clarification, or inquiries concerning this solicitation will be provided to all offerors, posted on sam.gov by December 9, 2026, and shall be directed to both designated Contracting Officers: Primary: Tabitha Rambert, Contracting Officer (tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov) Alternate: Juvonna Mattox, Contracting Officer (juvonna.mattox@sepa.doe.gov) Any changes or clarifications affecting solicitation requirements will be communicated through an official solicitation amendment, as appropriate (via Sam.gov). Submission Timeline Site Visit: November 19, 2026, at 10:30am and November 30, 2026 @1:00 pm, Eastern Time Deadline for submission of all questions will be December 4, 2026 @12:00 pm Eastern time and Deadline for responses will be December 9, 2026, on Sam.gov Bid Submission Deadline: 3pm Eastern Time on December 15, 2026 Expected Decision Date: December 31, 2026 Vendor Start date: Within 30 days of Award Please submit all proposals to the CO via email at: tabitha.rambert@sepa.doe.gov or via mail to:1166 Athens Tech Rd Elberton, GA 30635 before Bid Submission Deadline: 3pm Eastern Time on December 15, 2026. Vendor close-out date: NLT 2 Months from the vendor start date NOTE TO OFFERORS: The Statement of Work (SOW), applicable Wage Determinations, and Aeriel View are incorporated as attachments to this announcement. Offerors are responsible for thoroughly reviewing the solicitation and all accompanying attachments to ensure that their proposals comply with the stated requirements, and all are submitted by the specified deadline. Any amendments to the solicitation will be posted on this website. You are responsible for checking the website periodically. All offerors MUST be registered in System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov to be eligible for award of contract. The Government will evaluate proposals in accordance with the evaluation criteria established in the solicitation and applicable provisions of the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR). The Government reserves the right to make an award to the responsible offeror, whose proposal represents the best overall value to the Government, considering the stated evaluation factors.

title: FILTER ELEMENT, FLUID / QPL NSN 1650-00-484-6918 / B-52 AIRCRAFT
description: An Unrestricted solicitation will be issued to establish an Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC) for NSN 1650-00-484-6918, a FILTER ELEMENT, FLUID. The award will be for a 5-year base period. The Estimated Annual Quantity (EAQ) is 1520 EACH. Production units will be FOB: Destination; Inspection /Acceptance: Origin. Item is critical and deemed an Air Force Critical Safety Item. Surge applies (MWR = 8 each). The proposed contract action is for supplies for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one or a limited number of sources under the authority of FAR 6.302. This is a QPL item IAW BASIC SPEC NR MIL-PRF-83860D NOT 2, REVISION NR D DTD 09/18/2025, PPN: P/N M83860/4-3. Approved QPL sources are PTI Technologies (CAGE 05228) and Pall Aeropower (CAGE 18350). DLA Weapons Support - Richmond does NOT possess complete technical data on this part. There are no other approved sources at this time. Any other interested contractor would have to submit a Source Approval Request (SAR) package for approval to be added as a source by the assigned ESA. Interested persons may identify their interest and capability to respond to the requirement or submit proposals. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. However, all proposals received within forty-five days after date of publication of this synopsis will be considered by the Government. A determination by the Government not to compete with this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. Information received will normally be considered solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement. Based upon market research, the Government is not using the policies contained in Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items, in its solicitation for the described supplies. However, interested persons may identify to the contracting officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government's requirement with a commercial item within 15 days of this notice. This solicitation may include Procurement Note L09, Reverse Auction. Since a reverse auction may be conducted, offerors are encouraged to access the Procurex system and review the reverse auction help tutorials at https//dla.procurexinc.com to learn more about how to participate in an auction. In order to receive an award, regardless of dollar value, contractors must be registered in the System For Award Management (sam.gov). The final contract award decision may be based upon a combination of price, past performance and other evaluation factors as described in the solicitation. The estimated solicitation issue date is 11/13/2026. A copy of the solicitation will be available via DIBBS at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil/ on the issue date cited in the RFP. Choose the RFP you wish to download. RFPs are in portable document format (PDF). To download and view these documents you will need the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader. This software is available free at http://www.adobe.com. A paper copy of this solicitation will not be available to requesters.

Konzultace není zadávacím řízením. Účast v ní ani neúčast nezakládá žádné právo ani povinnost dodavatele či zadavatele, sdělené ceny jsou orientační a nezávazné. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: DC Recruiter
description: DC Recruiter: Broad-Spectrum Immune Enhancer from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a differentiated approach to multi-pathogen infection prevention by using a self-assembling peptide nanofiber to recruit and activate dendritic cells (DCs), the immune system�s natural sentinels. Unlike pathogen-specific vaccines or therapeutics, it is designed to help trigger an early immune response regardless of the infecting agent. Its needle-free, spray-friendly concept adds practicality. The Challenge: DC Recruiter addresses a persistent and highly consequential gap in infection management: the need for a rapid, broadly effective way to stimulate immune defense before the specific pathogen is known. In many exposure scenarios, the body encounters a threat before clinicians can identify the cause, and that delay can reduce the effectiveness of conventional interventions. Current vaccines, antibiotics and antivirals are generally designed to act against a known target, which limits their usefulness when exposure is unexpected, diagnosis is delayed or the pathogen is unfamiliar. That limitation creates a clear unmet need for a fast-acting, broad-spectrum approach that can be deployed early, with minimal complexity, and in settings where rapid response matters most, including outbreak situations, field environments and other high-risk conditions. Problems Solved: DC Recruiter solves this problem by using a specific peptide selected to bind to dendritic cells. By leveraging a self-assembling peptide nanofiber platform, the technology is designed to help �wake up� immune surveillance early, before infection can progress unchecked. Rather than relying on a treatment matched to one virus or bacterium, it creates the potential for broad-spectrum immune support across many different infectious threats. Its ability to provide broad-spectrum immune support makes it especially compelling for situations where time is critical and conventional options may be too specific, too slow or too late to provide immediate protection. The needle-free, spray-friendly concept also adds practical value by supporting easier administration and broader accessibility, strengthening its fit for real-world use cases that demand rapid, flexible deployment. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform
description: The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory provides a new way to study entire bacterial membranes in a controlled, nanoscale format derived directly from native lipid extracts. Researchers gain access to membrane components that typically remain difficult to isolate, stabilize or analyze, enabling more accurate evaluation of immunogenic lipids and membrane?associated targets. The platform offers a safer alternative to handling live high?risk pathogens while preserving the biological context that drives meaningful insights for vaccine design and antimicrobial discovery such as therapeutic antibodies to conserved lipids on bacterial membranes. How it Works The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform creates uniform nanoscale discs from total lipid extracts harvested from bacterial membranes. Membrane scaffold protein MSP1D1 encases the lipid mixture and forms a stable disc roughly 10 nanometers wide. The resulting particles retain the full complement of native bacterial lipids, arranged in a membrane?like environment that supports realistic biological interactions without requiring synthetic lipids or live cells. Technical Description The method adapts established nanodisc assembly techniques to incorporate entire bacterial lipid extracts rather than defined synthetic lipid mixtures. Total lipids from a pathogen are solubilized, combined with MSP1D1 and dialyzed under controlled conditions to allow the scaffold protein to form a discoidal structure around the heterogeneous lipid population. The process yields nanoparticles that represent the membrane environment of the source organism, including amphiphilic molecules that typically resist purification or structural study when isolated from their native context. The approach was demonstrated using Yersinia pestis, chosen to illustrate how membrane characterization can proceed without the hazards associated with live Tier 1 pathogens. The method captures lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and diverse immunogenic lipids in an arrangement that mirrors their natural organization. Researchers can evaluate binding interactions, immune?stimulating properties and potential antigenic targets in a stable platform that avoids the limitations of outer membrane vesicle purification. Furthermore, using this platform we have identified antibodies specific to E. coli LPS and Y. pestis membrane lipids. These antibodies are independently licensable. Advantages � Provides membrane?like structures using native bacterial lipids � Avoids the safety challenges of handling live pathogens � Offers a broader and more realistic lipid environment than synthetic nanodiscs � Enables improved assessment of membrane antigens and immune responses � Supports analysis of diverse bacterial species using a unified workflow � Creates consistent nanoscale particles suitable for research and development settings Market Applications � Life Sciences Research (membrane biology, immunology) � Vaccine Development (bacterial antigen discovery) � Drug Discovery (membrane?associated targets) � Diagnostics (lipid biomarker exploration) � Biodefense Research (safe pathogen characterization) Development Status: TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-24920 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. Researchers gain access to membrane components that typically remain difficult to isolate, stabilize or analyze, enabling more accurate evaluation of immunogenic lipids and membrane?associated targets. The platform offers a safer alternative to handling live high?risk pathogens while preserving the biological context that drives meaningful insights for vaccine design and antimicrobial discovery such as therapeutic antibodies to conserved lipids on bacterial membranes. How it Works The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform creates uniform nanoscale discs from total lipid extracts harvested from bacterial membranes. Membrane scaffold protein MSP1D1 encases the lipid mixture and forms a stable disc roughly 10 nanometers wide. The resulting particles retain the full complement of native bacterial lipids, arranged in a membrane?like environment that supports realistic biological interactions without requiring synthetic lipids or live cells. Technical Description The method adapts established nanodisc assembly techniques to incorporate entire bacterial lipid extracts rather than defined synthetic lipid mixtures. Total lipids from a pathogen are solubilized, combined with MSP1D1 and dialyzed under controlled conditions to allow the scaffold protein to form a discoidal structure around the heterogeneous lipid population. The process yields nanoparticles that represent the membrane environment of the source organism, including amphiphilic molecules that typically resist purification or structural study when isolated from their native context. The approach was demonstrated using Yersinia pestis, chosen to illustrate how membrane characterization can proceed without the hazards associated with live Tier 1 pathogens. The method captures lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and diverse immunogenic lipids in an arrangement that mirrors their natural organization. Researchers can evaluate binding interactions, immune?stimulating properties and potential antigenic targets in a stable platform that avoids the limitations of outer membrane vesicle purification. Furthermore, using this platform we have identified antibodies specific to E. coli LPS and Y. pestis membrane lipids. These antibodies are independently licensable. Advantages � Provides membrane?like structures using native bacterial lipids � Avoids the safety challenges of handling live pathogens � Offers a broader and more realistic lipid environment than synthetic nanodiscs � Enables improved assessment of membrane antigens and immune responses � Supports analysis of diverse bacterial species using a unified workflow � Creates consistent nanoscale particles suitable for research and development settings Market Applications � Life Sciences Research (membrane biology, immunology) � Vaccine Development (bacterial antigen discovery) � Drug Discovery (membrane?associated targets) � Diagnostics (lipid biomarker exploration) � Biodefense Research (safe pathogen characterization) Development Status: TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-24920 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. description: Provincie Limburg wil voor het technisch onderhoud, en de hieraan verbonden herstellingen, van de HVAC-installaties van de gebouwen van het provinciebestuur Limburg overgaan tot het opstellen van een raamovereenkomst. De raamovereenkomst wordt afgesloten voor de duur van 4 jaar. Deze raamovereenkomst heeft als doel te voorzien in: Deel 1: Wettelijk verplicht onderhoud - uitgevoerd door het eigen personeel van de opdrachtnemer (met de vereiste erkenningen) of erkende keuringsorganismes. - een jaarlijks nazicht van de stooktoestellen op stookolie en op gasvormige brandstoffen. - voor de koeltoestellen zal de dienstverlener ervoor zorgen dat de verplichtingen inzake onderhoud en nazicht worden nageleefd. - de dienstverlener staat in voor een dichtheidsmeting van de gasleidingen. Deel 2: Preventief onderhoud - bijkomend onderhoud bovenop de wettelijke vereisten, dat op regelmatige tijdstippen of op basis van de bedrijfsuren dient te gebeuren met als doel: - het bevorderen van de levensduur van de installaties; - het voorkomen van gevaarlijke toestanden; - het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - het energieverbruik zo laag mogelijk te houden. Deel 3: Correctief onderhoud - onderhoud dat uitgevoerd wordt wanneer defecten zich voordoen: - storingen en defecten herstellen binnen de overeengekomen tijd; - de prijs voor de wisselstukken wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; Deel 4: Deelopdrachten - uitvoeren van werken in het kader van afbraak, vernieuwing en/of uitbreiding van technische installaties: - per deelopdracht wordt een afzonderlijk dienstbevel gegeven, waarbij aard en omvang van de werken, aanvangsdatum en uitvoeringstermijn worden opgegeven. Een eigen pv van vaststelling voor aanvaarding van de werken van de deelopdracht (deel-oplevering) zal worden opgemaakt, conform de bepalingen van dit bestek; - op basis van een prijs per uur voor de werkuren; - de prijs voor de nodige materialen wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; - er kan geen minimum aantal werkuren noch een minimum bedrag aan deelopdrachten bepaald worden. Deel 5: Wisselstukken op basis van een verhogingspercentage - het bedrag dat jaarlijks wordt voorzien voor de nodige wisselstukken (preventief onderhoud, correctief onderhoud en deelopdrachten) wordt vastgelegd op € 100 000 exclusief btw. De combinatie van deze interventies heeft als doel: - het bewerkstelligen van de bedrijfszekerheid; - het garanderen van een veilige werking; - Het voorkomen van gevaarlijke situaties; - Het bevorderen van de levensduur van de technische installaties, d.w.z. er voor zorgen dat de installaties, gezien vanuit economische en/of technische overwegingen, zo lang mogelijk meegaan; - Het materiaal behoeden voor beschadiging; - Het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - Het herstellen van defecten; - Het energieverbruik te minimaliseren; - Plaatsen en in dienst stellen van bijkomende HVAC-installaties via deelopdrachten.

description: 1. Postępowanie prowadzone jest zgodnie z przepisami ustawy z dnia 11 września 2019 r. Prawo zamówień publicznych (Dz.U. z 2026 r. poz.793) zwana dalej ustawą Pzp Zamawiający udziela zamówienia w częściach, z których każda stanowi przedmiot odrębnego postępowania. 2. Zamawiający udziela zamówienia w częściach, z których każda stanowi przedmiot odrębnego postępowania o udzielenie zamówienia, zgodnie z art. 91 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp. Postępowanie prowadzone jest w celu zawarcia umowy ramowej w trybie przetargu nieograniczonego, na podstawie art. 311 ust. 1 pkt 1 w związku z art. 132 ustawy Pzp. Zamawiający zamierza zawrzeć umowę ramową z jednym Wykonawcą. Możliwość zawarcia umowy ramowej z jednym Wykonawcą wynika z art. 313 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp, który dopuszcza zawarcie umowy ramowej z jednym Wykonawcą. 3. [pkt 3 dotyczy wszystkich części zamówienia] Zamawiający przewiduje możliwość jednokrotnego wznowienia zamówienia na okres kolejnych 24 miesięcy, do wysokości wynagrodzenia. Wznowienie rozpoczyna się w dniu następującym po dniu upływu podstawowego okresu obowiązywania Umowy. Wznowienie polega na realizacji tego samego świadczenia (o tożsamym zakresie rzeczowym) na tych samych określonych w Umowie warunkach (nie wymaga zawarcia aneksu do Umowy). Wartość wznowienia jednokrotnego „odgórnie jest narzucona", jako tożsama z wartością zamówienia podstawowego i jest obliczana na podstawie wskazanych cen jednostkowych. Do wznowionego zamówienia mają zastosowanie wszystkie postanowienia Projektowanych postanowień mowy. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest: dostawa fabrycznie nowych części zamiennych i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do pojazdów ciężarowych, autobusów i akumulatorów z podziałem na 3 (trzy) części zamówienia. Część I – dostawa akumulatorów do pojazdów osobowych, dostawczych, mikrobusów, ciężarowych i autobusów. Część II – dostawa części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do pojazdów ciężarowych, Część III – dostawa części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do autobusów. Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia określają załączniki nr 1, 1.1 - 1.3. oraz 4.1. – 4.2. do SWZ tj.: Formularz ofertowy wraz ze Specyfikacją asortymentowo - cenową oraz Projektowane postanowienia umowy. Orientacyjny zakres wraz z ilościami przedmiotu zamówienia określono w załączniku nr 1.1. – 1.3. treści SWZ, sporządzony na bazie przewidywanych, orientacyjnych potrzeb (obsługowo - naprawczych) na lata 2027, 2028 oraz 2029. Zamawiający nie dysponuje wiedzą na temat dokładnych ilości, rodzaju oraz terminu realizacji swoich potrzeb związanych z obsługą techniczną, konserwacją i naprawami pojazdów pozostających w jego dyspozycji, jakie w przyszłości mają być zaspokojone. Rzeczywiste zapotrzebowanie Zamawiającego będzie uzależnione w szczególności od liczby i rodzaju eksploatowanych pojazdów, ich stanu technicznego, intensywności eksploatacji, przebiegu, stopnia zużycia poszczególnych podzespołów i elementów, a także od zakresu i częstotliwości wykonywanych okresowych przeglądów technicznych, w tym przeglądów rocznych, planowych wymian części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych, jak również od rodzaju, zakresu i częstotliwości występujących awarii i usterek oraz konieczności przeprowadzania napraw pojazdów. Zapotrzebowanie będzie obejmowało części i materiały eksploatacyjne niezbędne zarówno do realizacji planowych czynności obsługowych i konserwacyjnych, jak i do usuwania awarii, usterek oraz wykonywania napraw eksploatowanych pojazdów. W związku z powyższym rzeczywiste ilości i rodzaj zamawianego asortymentu, częstotliwość składania zamówień oraz terminy realizacji poszczególnych zamówień wykonawczych mogą różnić się od ilości orientacyjnych wskazanych w załącznikach nr 1.1 – 1.3 do SWZ. Zamawiający będzie udzielał zamówień wykonawczych sukcesywnie, stosownie do rzeczywistych potrzeb wynikających z konieczności zapewnienia sprawności technicznej i ciągłości eksploatacji pojazdów, w granicach przedmiotu i maksymalnej wartości umowy ramowej. Zawarcie umowy ramowej nie oznacza zobowiązania Zamawiającego do zamówienia wszystkich pozycji asortymentowych ani wykorzystania pełnych ilości określonych w załącznikach nr 1.1 – 1.3. do SWZ. Wykonawca powinien uwzględnić szacunkowy charakter przedstawionych ilości przy kalkulacji oferty, z zastrzeżeniem zasad i warunków realizacji zamówień określonych w SWZ oraz umowie ramowej. Zamawiający zastrzega sobie prawo do zlecania dostaw asortymentu w ilościach mniejszych lub większych od ilości orientacyjnych wskazanych załącznikach.1.1 – 1.3. treści SWZ, z zastrzeżeniem, że łączna wartość wynagrodzenia Wykonawcy z tytułu realizacji umowy nie może przekroczyć wartości wynagrodzenia określonej w umowie. Zamawiający dopuszcza składanie ofert częściowych, z których każda będzie oceniana przez Zamawiającego oddzielnie, według zasad opisanych w SWZ. Zamówienie podzielone zostało na części, zgodnie z opisem zawartym w załącznikach nr 1.1. – 1.3. do SWZ. Każdy z Wykonawców może złożyć ofertę na dowolnie wybraną część/części. Zamawiający wymaga złożenia oferty na wszystkie wymagane pozycje wykazane w załącznikach nr 1.1. – 1.3. do SWZ. Ilekroć w niniejszej SWZ przedmiot zamówienia jest opisany ze wskazaniem znaków towarowych, patentów lub pochodzenia, źródła lub szczególnego procesu, który charakteryzuje produkty dostarczane przez konkretnego Wykonawcę, jeżeli mogłoby to doprowadzić do uprzywilejowania lub wyeliminowania niektórych wykonawców lub produktów, to przyjmuje się, że wskazaniom takim towarzyszą wyrazy „lub równoważne”. Zamawiający, opisując przedmiot zamówienia, na podstawie dyspozycji wyrażonej w art. 99 ustawy Pzp, wskazał na znak towarowy lub pochodzenie z uwagi na specyfikę przedmiotu zamówienia oraz brak możliwości jego opisania w sposób wyczerpujący za pomocą dokładnych i zrozumiałych określeń.

title: Germany – Construction consultancy services – Bedarfsplanung (Phase Null) und Beratung zur Standort- und Grundstücksfrage für den Neubau der Grundschule Sandkrug
description: Der Rat der Gemeinde Hatten hat die Realisierung der Grundschule (GS) Sandkrug als Neubau an einem Einzelstandort beschlossen. Vorangegangen war eine Machbarkeitsstudie, die im Jahr 2019 erstellt und 2025 aktualisiert wurde, die alle drei Grundschulstandorte im Bestand betrachtet hat. Untersucht wurden je Standort verschiedene Realisierungsvarianten; der Rat der Gemeinde Hatten hat sich für den Neubau der GS Sandkrug an einem Standort entschieden, d.h. dass die bisherigen Grundschulstandorte Sandkrug und Streekermoor zusammengeführt und in dem zu realisierenden Neubau gemeinsam untergebracht werden. So soll eine vierzügige Grundschule entstehen, mit einem derzeit geschätzten Investitionsvolumen von ca. 20 Mio. EUR (brutto). Die Gemeinde Hatten beabsichtigt daher in diesem Zusammenhang, die Bedarfsplanung ("Phase Null") und die daran anschließende Beratung zur Standort- und Grundstücksfrage für den Neubau der GS Sandkrug an einen Auftragnehmer zu vergeben.
